description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Water 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rikku], [Mix Ability Tracker] and [Mix Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Water 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Water damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rikku
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Mix (0~2), removed after using Mix two times

description.name: Mix Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Mix level by 1 after using 8 Thief or Dancer abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rikku]

description.name: Mix Level
description.text: Keeps track of Mix level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rikku]
